description_en: Queries operation logs by calling DescribeOpEntities
name: DescribeOpEntities

parameters.help_en: The source IP address of the request. You do not need to specify this parameter. The system automatically obtains the value
parameters.help_zh: 请求源IP。无需填写，系统自动获取
parameters.name: source_ip

parameters.help_en:
The type of the object to filter. Valid values:

1: IP address.
2: Anti-DDoS Pro instance.
3: ECS instance.

Used together with the EntityObject parameter to perform exact matching based on the specified filter object and filter operation log records
parameters.help_zh:
过滤条件对象，取值：

1：表示IP。
2：表示抗D包。
3：表示ECS。

结合EntityObject参数，根据指定的过滤条件对象进行精确匹配，筛选操作日志记录
parameters.name: entity_type

parameters.help_en: The filter content. Only exact matching is supported
parameters.help_zh: 过滤条件内容，仅支持精确匹配
parameters.name: entity_object

parameters.help_en: The start time. The value is a timestamp. Unit: milliseconds
parameters.help_zh: 开始时间。格式为时间戳，单位：毫秒
parameters.name: start_time

parameters.help_en: The end time. The value is a timestamp. Unit: milliseconds
parameters.help_zh: 结束时间。格式为时间戳，单位：毫秒
parameters.name: end_time

parameters.help_en: The page number, which indicates the page from which results start to be displayed
parameters.help_zh: 页号，即从第几页开始显示
parameters.name: page_no

parameters.help_en: The page size, which indicates the number of results displayed on each page. Maximum value: 50
parameters.help_zh: 分页大小，即每页显示多少条结果。最大值50。
parameters.name: page_size

EntityObject.description_en: The value of the operation object, which is the IP address that is operated on
EntityObject.description_zh: 操作对象的值，即操作的IP地址

EntityType.description_en: The object type. Valid values: 1 (IP address)
EntityType.description_zh: 操作对象类型。取值：1（IP类型）。

GmtCreate.description_en: The timestamp when the log was created. Unit: milliseconds
GmtCreate.description_zh: 创建日志的时间戳，单位：毫秒

OpAction.description_en: The operation type. Valid values: 1 (modify burstable bandwidth)
OpAction.description_zh: 操作类型。取值：1（修改弹性带宽）。

OpDesc.description_en:
The operation details. The JSON string of OpDesc has the following structure:

oldValue, Struct type, the old value, which has the following structure:
    - elasticBandwidth, Integer type, the burstable bandwidth value.
newValue, Struct type, the new value, which has the following structure:
    - elasticBandwidth, Integer type, the burstable bandwidth value
OpDesc.description_zh:
操作详情。OpDesc的JSON字符串，具体结构描述如下：

oldValue，Struct类型，旧值，具体结构描述如下：
    - elasticBandwidth，Integer类型，弹性带宽值。
newValue，Struct类型，新值，具体结构描述如下：
    - elasticBandwidth，Integer类型，弹性带宽值
